_comment: Curated Claude Code skills/plugins per fleet persona. Sourced from 14 parallel research agents (see docs/skills-research-report.md). Edit freely. License followups must be resolved before baking into the redistributed Docker image.

shared_baseline._note: Recommended for ALL personas — code intelligence, PR workflow, browser automation. These show up in many persona reports and provide cross-cutting value.

recommended.name: github
recommended.why: Official GitHub MCP server — required for any persona that opens PRs or queries Actions/issues.

recommended.name: commit-commands
recommended.why: Anthropic-curated /commit, /commit-push-pr, /clean_gone with safe tool allowlists.

recommended.name: atlassian
recommended.why: Ships spec-to-backlog skill that encodes this persona's algorithm: fetch spec → analyze → break into Epic+children → create tickets.

recommended.name: feature-dev
recommended.why: 7-phase workflow (Discovery → Codebase Exploration → Clarifying Questions → Architecture → Task Breakdown). Discovery + Task Breakdown phases match this persona 1:1.

recommended.name: agent-skills (planning-and-task-breakdown + spec-driven-development)
recommended.why: Cleanest first-principles task-decomposition skill: decompose into verifiable tasks with explicit acceptance criteria, map dependency graphs, plan-mode discipline.

consider.name: pm-execution
consider.why: PRD/user-story templates as fallback when input PRDs are weak.

consider.name: linear
consider.why: Only if/when fleet switches off Jira to Linear.

license_blocked.name: Product-Manager-Skills (epic-breakdown-advisor)
license_blocked.blocker: NonCommercial clause — cannot bake into commercial open-source product. Best content for vertical-slice splitting (Humanizing Work patterns); paraphrase or request license carve-out.

recommended.name: frontend-design
recommended.why: Anthropic's canonical 'distinctive, production-grade UI' skill. Aesthetic vocabulary, anti-AI-slop heuristics, design thinking framework.

recommended.name: react-best-practices (Vercel)
recommended.why: 70 prioritized React/Next.js performance rules — bundle size, waterfalls, re-render, server perf.

recommended.name: web-design-guidelines (Vercel)
recommended.why: 100+ rule audit rubric: a11y, focus states, forms, animation (prefers-reduced-motion), typography, dark mode, touch.

consider.name: composition-patterns (Vercel)
consider.why: Compound components, lifting state, avoiding boolean prop proliferation.

consider.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
consider.why: Inspect reference sites for layout/perf/a11y observations.

license_followups: vercel-labs/agent-skills declares MIT in README + SKILL.md frontmatter but ships no top-level LICENSE file. File an issue asking them to add one before redistributing in a Docker image.

recommended.name: SwiftUI Pro
recommended.author: Paul Hudson (Hacking with Swift)
recommended.why: Navigation, layout, animations, state management, accessibility, VoiceOver for iOS 26 / Swift 6.2+. Scoped to 'mistakes LLMs make'.

recommended.name: apple-skills
recommended.why: Only candidate with dedicated `hig` skill plus `ios-design-consultant`, `ios-ui-craft`, `ios-liquid-glass`.

recommended.name: swiftui-design-skill
recommended.why: Visual-design oriented (typography, color systems, layout patterns, anti-AI-slop).

consider.name: Swift Concurrency Pro
consider.why: Pair with SwiftUI Pro when design docs specify async/await, MainActor, Sendable boundaries.

consider.name: Axiom
consider.why: 237 skills incl. axiom-swiftui/axiom-design/axiom-accessibility. Heavyweight; tooling features (xclog, xcsym) won't run in container.

license_blocked.name: swift-ios-skills
license_blocked.blocker: Source-available, NOT OSI-approved. Forbids competing products. Technically allowed if Hub doesn't compete, but legal review required before bundling in public Docker image.

recommended.name: android-skills (Google)
recommended.why: Google-authored skills for jetpack-compose/adaptive (NavigationSuiteScaffold, Navigation 3, list-detail/supporting pane), theming, navigation-3. Highest authority.

recommended.name: android-skills (rcosteira79)
recommended.why: Fills gaps Google leaves: state management, UX patterns, kotlin-coroutines/flows.

skipped_dangerous.name: aihip/android-claude-code-skills
skipped_dangerous.reason: No LICENSE, and figma-to-android skill explicitly forbids Jetpack Compose — actively contradicts the persona's mandate.

recommended.name: aws-core
recommended.why: aws-messaging-and-streaming (SQS/SNS/EventBridge/Kinesis pattern selection) + CDK/CloudFormation/IAM/observability. Anchors AWS-centric backend design.

recommended.name: feature-dev (code-architect agent)
recommended.why: code-architect subagent prompt is a working spec for backend design docs (component design, data flow, build sequence, trade-offs).

recommended.name: mongodb
recommended.why: mongodb-schema-design (embed vs reference, polymorphic, time-series, anti-patterns) + query-optimizer + atlas-stream-processing.

recommended.name: clickhouse-best-practices + architecture-advisor
recommended.why: Architecture decision-framework skill + 28 prioritized rules. Pick this OR mongodb based on workload (OLTP-document vs OLAP-columnar).

consider.name: azure
consider.why: 27 skills incl. enterprise-infra-planner, messaging, reliability. Promote to recommended if Azure is primary target.

consider.name: redis-development
consider.why: Caching strategy section of design docs.

consider.name: cosmosdb-best-practices
consider.why: 73 best-practice rules; data modeling, partition-key design.

recommended.name: security-guidance
recommended.why: Curated catalog of ~25 vulnerability classes mapped to OWASP — injection, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, auth bypass, unsafe deserialization, hardcoded secrets, GH Actions injection. Authored by Anthropic security team. NOTE: hooks fire on Edit/Stop/git-commit; set SECURITY_GUIDANCE_DISABLE=1 if hook noise on doc edits is a problem. Bake for the embedded knowledge.

consider.name: claude-skill-security-check
consider.why: Single SKILL.md is 'review pending changes against OWASP, do not modify code, report findings' — closest match to persona's job. Caveat: prose is in Portuguese.

consider.name: auth0
consider.why: Only when reviewed feature involves login/sessions/protected routes.

skipped_with_reason: All vendor SAST plugins (semgrep, aikido, sonarqube, snyk, sonatype, jfrog, 42crunch, nightvision) — they wrap MCP servers requiring vendor accounts AND a code artifact to scan. Useless for a persona that reviews narrative design docs.

recommended.name: claude-wcag-accessibility-skill
recommended.why: Triggers on legal accessibility regimes (ADA, EAA 2025, EN 301 549, Section 508, AODA, VPAT/ACR). Covers WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA. Caveat: low star count — verify SKILL.md depth before baking.

recommended.name: twilio-developer-kit (compliance subskills only)
recommended.why: Best vendor-authored coverage of GDPR consent, HIPAA BAA/PHI, PCI DSS, TCPA, FDCPA, CAN-SPAM. Pull only the 4 compliance subdirs.

consider.name: soc2-startup
consider.why: 7 named roles (Lean Guardian, Policy Writer, Gap Analyzer, Evidence Collector, Risk Assessor) + CC1-CC9 reference. Self-contained, no external services. Caveat: single-author repo.

legal_compliance.honest_caveat: Niche space. Anthropic marketplace has only 2 compliance plugins (legalzoom, vanta) and both are MCP-server-dependent. The persona's prompt + these 3 picks is probably stronger than chasing more plugins of marginal quality.

recommended.name: flutter-localization-audit-skill
recommended.why: Closest direct analogue to the persona's job: multi-category audit producing markdown report. references/localization_checks.md is reusable beyond Flutter.

recommended.name: crowdin/skills (context-extraction)
recommended.why: Only vendor-official skill set in this space. Teaches translator-quality ai_context for ambiguous strings (short verbs, color/status names, ICU plurals). LICENSE FOLLOWUP REQUIRED.

recommended.name: xcstrings-localizer
recommended.why: Best CLDR-plurals + cross-language grammar/terminology-consistency reference. references/cldr-plural-rules.md covers 40+ languages. Reusable beyond iOS.

localization.honest_caveat: Niche, immature space. All top picks are <10 stars, <6 months old. Plan to fork+harden one, or treat as starter scaffolding.

recommended.name: amplitude
recommended.why: 27 skills covering instrument-events, taxonomy, discover-event-surfaces, create-chart, create-dashboard, monitor-experiments, monitor-reliability — entire event-schema → dashboard → KPI loop.

recommended.name: posthog
recommended.why: Broadest single plugin: instrument-product-analytics, error-tracking, llm-analytics, feature-flags, log-alerts, experiments, RUM autocapture, APM/LLM trace exploration.

recommended.name: sentry-for-claude
recommended.why: Strongest skills for alerting + frontend RUM + AI observability. 20+ SDK-specific instrumentation skills.

recommended.name: honeycomb
recommended.why: Best for distributed-tracing + SLO design. otel-instrumentation, slos-and-triggers, query-patterns, production-investigation.

license_followups: amplitude/mcp-marketplace and PostHog/ai-plugin both declare MIT in README but ship no LICENSE file. File issues asking vendors to add one before bundling.

recommended.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
recommended.why: Browser-tested components: perf traces, network, console with sourcemaps, Lighthouse, screenshots.

recommended.name: context7
recommended.why: Version-pinned framework docs — counters Claude hallucinating outdated React/Next/Tailwind APIs.

recommended.name: typescript-lsp
recommended.why: Go-to-def, find-refs, type errors. Requires npm install -g typescript-language-server typescript in image.

recommended.name: code-review
recommended.why: Self-review pass before opening PR.

recommended.name: aws-serverless
recommended.why: api-gateway + aws-lambda + durable-functions. Direct fit for 'writes Lambdas, API handlers'.

recommended.name: aws-dev-toolkit
recommended.why: 34 service-specific skills. MIT-0 cleanest possible license. Pin to specific commit SHA — only 7 stars.

recommended.name: apollo-skills
recommended.why: GraphQL schema design, federation, Apollo Server/Router, Connectors, graphql-operations.

recommended.name: aws-serverless
recommended.why: api-gateway skill: REST scaffolding, throttling, request/response models, authorizers.

recommended.name: 42crunch-api-security-testing
recommended.why: OpenAPI-first audit/scan/remediate aligned with OWASP API Top 10 (BOLA/BFLA).

recommended.name: postman
recommended.why: agent-ready-apis, generate-spec, run-collection — OpenAPI gen + contract testing.

consider.name: auth0
consider.why: Only if Auth0 is the IdP.

recommended.name: pr-review-toolkit
recommended.why: 6 specialist agents: pr-test-analyzer, silent-failure-hunter, code-reviewer, comment-analyzer, type-design-analyzer, code-simplifier. Purpose-built for verification.

recommended.name: superpowers
recommended.why: verification-before-completion, systematic-debugging ('NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE'), test-driven-development. Procedural gates that match verifier discipline.

recommended.name: playwright
recommended.why: Standard browser-driving MCP for E2E verification.

recommended.name: code-review
recommended.why: 5-parallel-Sonnet review with confidence scoring ≥80 gating.

consider.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
consider.why: Perf traces, console with sourcemaps. Complementary to Playwright.

recommended.name: commit-commands
recommended.why: /commit, /commit-push-pr, /clean_gone with curated tool allowlists.

recommended.name: github (MCP)
recommended.why: Beyond gh CLI: Actions API for workflow runs, jobs, logs.

recommended.name: aws-core
recommended.why: CDK + CloudFormation + IAM for deployment.

consider.name: buildkite
consider.why: Only if Buildkite is the CI.

ci_agent.honest_gap: No popular GitHub Actions YAML authoring plugin exists yet. Closest unofficial matches are 0 stars. Persona can encode workflow conventions in CLAUDE.md.

license_blocked_global.name: vercel-labs/skills (parent CLI repo)
license_blocked_global.blocker: Different from vercel-labs/agent-skills. This is the npx skills CLI itself. Has only ThirdPartyNoticeText.txt for bundled deps.

license_blocked_global.name: figma/mcp-server-guide
license_blocked_global.blocker: Beta, governed by commercial T&Cs. License blocks redistribution in a public open-source product Docker image.

license_blocked_global.name: grafana/pyroscope-skills
license_blocked_global.blocker: Strong copyleft. Skip for closed-source Docker image without legal review.

license_followups_global: vercel-labs/agent-skills — README + SKILL.md frontmatter say MIT but no top-level LICENSE file. File issue asking for one.
amplitude/mcp-marketplace — README declares MIT, no LICENSE file.
PostHog/ai-plugin — README declares MIT, no LICENSE file.
42crunch root repo — plugin subdir is Apache-2.0 but root has no LICENSE.
honeycombio/agent-skill, sentry-for-claude — confirmed proper LICENSE files (MIT). Clean.
